newsitem.title: UK: UK plans digital radio launch by 1999.
newsitem.headline: UK plans digital radio launch by 1999.

text.p: Britain's Radio Authority said on Monday that a new generation of commercial digital services should hit the airwaves by 1999.
The body confirmed the planned timetable for the digital launch in a letter to the Commercial Radio Companies Association.
More than 20 digital radio programme services and an array of additional text and data information should be available in large areas of the country by the turn of the century.
Listeners will have to buy a new radio to receive the services. These are expected to incorporate some form of display to provide text information accompanying radio programmes.
The Authority indicated that digital radio "multiplex" (frequency) licences will be advertised in spring 1998.
